questions.q_en: If the area of the base of a regular hexagonal pyramid is 384√3 m2 and the area of one of its faces is 128√3 m2, then find the volume of the pyramid.
questions.solution_en:
Area of base of hexagonal pyramid = 3√3/2 * base2

384√3 = 3√3/2 * base2

Base2 = 256 m2

base = 16 m

Area of one face = 1/2 * base * slant height

128√3 = 1/2 * 16 * slant height

Slant height = 16√3 m

Height = √[(16√3)3 - (16√3/2)2] = 24 m

The volume of the pyramid = 1/3 * area of hexagon * Height of the pyramid

= 1/3 * 384√3 * 24

= 3072√3 m3
